components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

      required:
        - message

      properties:

          minimum: 0

          type: string

        - id

## Summary

Implemented the optional, lower-cased, syntactically-validated `email` field on owners.

**Spec / DTO**
- `openapi.yml` — added an optional `email` string to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` carry it and Jackson (de)serializes it. MapStruct maps it by name automatically (no mapper change needed).

**Entity + persistence**
- `model/Owner.java` — added the `email` field with getter/setter.
- `db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql` — added a nullable `email` column to the `owners` table.

**Validation / normalization** (following the AGENTS.md "functions throw, handlers respond" idiom)
- `function/owner/OwnerEmail.java` — new shared helper: leaves a null/blank email untouched; otherwise trims, validates against the WHATWG email syntax, and lower-cases it in place (throwing when invalid).
- `function/owner/ValidateOwnerFields.java` (POST) and `ValidateOwner.java` (PUT) — call `OwnerEmail.normalize(...)` before publishing the body.
- `function/owner/ApplyOwner.java` — now copies `email` onto the entity on update.
- `escalation/InvalidOwnerEmailException.java` + `InvalidOwnerEmailExceptionHandler.java` + the matching `officefloor/escalation/…InvalidOwnerEmailException.yml` — a checked escalation that responds `400` with `{"errors":["email"]}`.

Net behavior: a present email must be syntactically valid (else 400), is stored and returned lower-cased, and a missing email is accepted — matching all three `Cp04Tests` cases, with no regression to the existing checkpoints.
